notes: How this part was researched: the session's web search allowance was already used up (200 of 200) before this part began, so no searching was possible. Pages were opened directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py), robots.txt read first and obeyed. Filed campaign websites were read from sl_websites in ballot_local_2026.sqlite (read-only). Campaign sites nobody filed, local party units' pages and news reports could not be found without searching, so a blank here is not proof that nothing exists; a second pass with searching would be worth it.

Not read, and nothing worked around: Roseau County's site showed a Radware CAPTCHA on the first request and was not asked again (nothing for Laura Phillipe Larson); Columbia Heights' site asks scripts to stay out in robots.txt (nothing for Robert Rogne); mncourts.gov was not asked, since it refuses scripts (nothing for Judge Rebekka Lynn Stumme); natalieforhouse.com (Natalie Zeleznikar) and stephforspps.com (Stephanie Anderson) answered the reader and the fetch tool with an empty page, so those filed addresses stay as filed and nothing is recorded from them; the Dassel-Cokato and St. Louis County (ISD 2142) school sites did not answer; the Albert Lea, Cambridge-Isanti and Saint Paul school board pages and the Olmsted County board page gave the reader no member names (lists loaded by script), so nothing could be read for Gary Schindler, Nikki Johnson, Stephanie Anderson or Michael Wojcik; the Fergus Falls council page was not found at the addresses tried (Scott Rachels).

Checked and not found on their government's own list of today's office holders, so nothing recorded: Pat Saum (Rock County lists Sherri Thompson for District 4), Tiffany Lesmeister-Knott (Redwood County lists Jim Salfer for District 2), Greg Copeland (Ramsey County lists Garrison McMurtrey for District 3), John Patrick Dierberger (Rogers), Chris Snyder (Moorhead Ward 2), Randall (Randy) Kight (Sartell-St. Stephen ISD 748), Anthony Robert Sinople (Maple Grove's own candidates page names him as a filed candidate, nothing more).

Left out on purpose: Cassidy Villeneuve appears in Itasca County's staff directory as an Assistant County Attorney, and Jason Seidl's campaign site calls him chief deputy; both are jobs, not offices, so neither is recorded. Private endorsements on campaign sites (a sitting mayor's on Teneshia Kragness's site) are not a party's own page. Jobs, schools and family on the official biographies were not taken.

Republican endorsements: the Republican Party of Minnesota's nominees page was not found at the address tried (404), and no local unit page could be found without searching, so nothing is recorded for Natalie Zeleznikar, Allen Shen or John Holmberg. No campaign site is on file for John Holmberg.

Privacy: while reading layouts, the reader's printed snippets included one campaign contact e-mail, two campaign mailing addresses and a few family names from official biography pages. None was stored or written anywhere; after the first, snippets were masked and shortened.
